== Title ==
<span lang="ja">やっかいかけたな</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに武器を使用する（フォースは通常通り使用する）。使用しているのがハンなら、運命数に1を加えられる。（シーカーを目標とすることもできる。シーカーは回避値4としてあつかう）命中を受けた目標は即座にロストする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「おまえを殺すのを楽しみにしてたんだ」「ああ、察しがつくぜ」ハンはグリードとの交渉に荒っぽく片をつけ、ウーハーに後始末料を投げてよこした。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Sorry About The Mess]].

'''Lore''' — I've been looking forward to killing you. Yeah, I figured. Han ended the talk with Greedo roughly and tossed Wuher a cleanup fee.

'''Game text''' — During your control phase, fire a weapon, using Force as usual. If Han is firing, you may add 1 to destiny. A seeker may be targeted. Treat a seeker as maneuver 4. A hit target is immediately lost.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Title is やっかいかけたな. Lore makes Greedo's line 'looking forward to killing you'; English is 'this for a long time.' Seeker uses 回避値4, not maneuver of 4 as a character weapon.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-sorryaboutthemess-decipher-archive-crop.png|Original English face]], [[Sorry About The Mess]].</ref>
